name: Sakuraba Makoto
source:
Kisataka High School sophomore.
He is a member of the "AI Research Department" and is in charge of programming the AI ​​system "Fubuki" with Naoto Sunahara.
He has a self-paced personality and loves games. He has been a close friend of Nazuna Nanamori since he met him when he was in elementary school.

[From [url=http://blue-cradle.com/%e6%a1%9c%e5%ba%ad%e7%9c%9f%e7%90%b4-2/]official website[/url]]
